boards.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0.1
boards.note: Intelligence Index v5 combines nine evaluations: AA-Briefcase, AutomationBench-AA, Terminal-Bench 4.0, FrontierCode 2.0, Omniscience, GDP.pdf, HLE Diamond, CritPt v2 Hard and Terminal-Bench Science.
